items.prompt: Derive n*H_n and explain why adding stage means does not itself need independent stages.
items.modelAnswer: On every path total is sum of waits. At j seen types iid uniform draws give new probability (n-j)/n, so positive-support wait mean n/(n-j). Linearity sums means regardless of stage dependence. Prime/range assumptions separately justify modular inverses; no decimal approximation suffices.

criteria.text: Uses linearity, not false independence requirement.
Separates exact expectation from modular representation.
